Type: rug
Name: Rivet Modern Flatwoven Rug with Intersecting Diamonds, 5' x 8', Blue and Gray with Gold
This contemporary rug will add texture, depth, and color wherever you have a bare floor or need to create visual interest in a room. Its classic coloring ensures that it will pair with many color schemes. Flatwoven wool and cotton mean this soft rug will bring warmth to any room. 5'W x 8'L 77% wool, 16% cotton, 7% Lurex Transitional design in colors that can be paired with any decor Flatweave (pile is not applicable) Pair with a rug pad (sold separately)
